messages.subject: Re: [nat-user] NBLAST online error

Dear Jason,

Many thanks for the heads up. Someone updated the OS on the server on Friday and in so doing the version of R which is what runs the underlying code. I have reinstalled the missing packages for the new version of R and the server appears to be running again normally now.

Best wishes,

Greg.
